sections.title: About Classic
sections.intro: Classic is where Speedometer started, in 2016: a big gauge on brushed metal with smaller gauges for battery, RAM, signal and Wi-Fi around it, an LCD clock and a row of warning lights. Steel and Graphite are Classic in new materials.

items.alt: The Classic style, as the wallpaper draws it
items.caption: Classic, drawn by the app itself

items.title: Free
items.text: Classic is free, like Steel and Graphite.

items.title: One dial, three jobs
items.text: The big gauge shows power, CPU clock or GPS speed. Tap it on your home screen to switch, as in every style.

items.title: Make it yours
items.text: Customize sets Classic's colours and background, and its units, clock and warning lights.

items.title: Layouts, and your own
items.text: Most styles come in several layouts. You can also drag and resize the gauges and save your own.

sections.title: Layouts made with Classic
sections.intro: Drivers built these layouts in Classic and shared them in the app's layout market, most used first. Every layout works in every style.

sections.title: More styles
sections.intro: Every style runs live on its own page. Or try them all in your browser.
